package graphs

var Calls int

type A struct{}

func NewA(*B) *A { Calls++; return &A{} }

type B struct{}

func NewB(*A) *B { Calls++; return &B{} }

//cratis:singleton
type Captive struct{}

func NewCaptive(*Scoped) *Captive { Calls++; return &Captive{} }

//cratis:scoped
type Scoped struct{}

func NewScoped() *Scoped { Calls++; return &Scoped{} }

type Missing struct{}
type Consumer struct{}

func NewConsumer(*Missing) *Consumer { Calls++; return &Consumer{} }
